selection.objective: maximum validation macro Recall@10; exact ties choose smaller alpha

mf.modelType: dot product plus training global mean, no user/item biases
mf.objective: batch MSE + 0.05 * (sum(all user factors squared) + sum(all movie factors squared))
mf.initialization: Mulberry32 seed 20261013; Box-Muller normal * 0.05; seeded shuffled batches
